summary: After migrating to Managed AAP, log in with the local admin to confirm the import, update SSO authenticators and mappings and private hub content for new URLs, run the Pulp repair POST, sync hub repositories, push custom EEs to the new hub and reconfigure automation mesh. Custom certificates, custom domains or private endpoints are requested from SRE via tickets.
